When on, the app checks GitHub each time this screen opens. Turn off to keep the app fully offline.
The stable, optimised and signed build. Recommended for everyday use. Opens the latest release on GitHub.
The preview build, published early so you can try the newest changes. Less tested than the release. Opens the preview on GitHub.
The app only contacts GitHub when you check or download — it sends no identifiers and never polls in the background. Downloads are verified against their published SHA-256 before install.
The bottom navigation now slides away as you scroll down and returns when you scroll up, and scrolling is smoother everywhere.
Home, Monitor, Tweaks, Profiles and System were redesigned with a calmer, grouped layout.
Monitor adds battery usage by app, RAM and ZRAM detail, and a ZKFC log you can export as a .zip.
Per-app language, new theme controls and brand-aware device identity.
This Update app screen, offering a debug and a release build, plus this changelog.
Loads the matching GKI module at boot and re-applies your saved profile.
